assumptions: Requests, contacts, duplicates, service categories, assignments, work orders, and outcomes remain distinct.
Channel and area comparisons account for taxonomy, access, publication, and reporting differences.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain the current distribution rule for public-service cases and response capacity.

constraints.description: The 311 and public-service demand operations allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief service officer and 311 operations director
decision_question: How should cases, language support, supervisors, and field capacity be assigned across queues?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The 311 and public-service demand operations allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for public-service cases and response capacity passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: skills-, urgency-, equity-, and SLA-constrained queue allocation
independence_key.primary_outcome: priority requests without assigned qualified capacity

intended_claim: A versioned allocate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting public-service cases and response capacity, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: priority requests without assigned qualified capacity
distributional gap in priority requests without assigned qualified capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report routed cases as contacted residents, completed work, or resolved outcomes.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for public-service cases and response capacity passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.

title: Allocate service cases and response capacity
